    Sample beta block-diagonally (fast path for large J0)

    dot-sample_beta_bd_blockdiag.Rd

    When X_block is block-diagonal with J0 blocks of size [T_j x K] and the prior precision is block-diagonal diag(J0) x diag(1/tau), the posterior precision A_bd = XtWX_bd/sigma2 + Sigma_beta_prior_inv is also block- diagonal. Factorising each [K x K] block independently reduces cost from O((K*J0)^3) to O(J0 * K^3). For K=1 each block is a scalar — the Cholesky collapses to a square root and the MVN draw to a single normal draw.

    .sample_beta_bd_blockdiag(
  XtWX_blocks,
  XtWy_blocks,
  tau,
  sigma2,
  K,
  prior_mean = NULL
)

    Arguments

    XtWX_blocks

    List of J0 matrices, each [K x K]: the j-th block of X_block'W X_block.

    XtWy_blocks

    List of J0 vectors, each length K: the j-th block of X_block'W y_tilde.

    tau

    Numeric vector length K: current dispersion SDs.

    sigma2

    Scalar: current observation noise variance.

    K

    Integer: covariates per unit.

    prior_mean

    Optional list of J0 vectors (prior mean per unit block). Default NULL gives zero prior mean.

    Value

    Numeric vector of length K*J0: sampled beta in stacked unit order.
